headline: We Win Limited declares financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September-quarter financials filed by We Win
summary: We Win Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. The filing provides the company's revenue and profit performance for the second quarter of the financial year. Retail investors can review these earnings numbers in the corporate filing section on the NSE website to assess the company's recent operational performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers determine earnings growth for We Win shareholders.

headline: We Win Limited bags contract for Uttarakhand 104 health helpline
hook: New public health contract in Uttarakhand
summary: We Win Limited has been awarded a contract to establish and operate the Integrated 104 Health Helpline, telemedical consultation, and grievance redressal services in Uttarakhand. The project will be managed through call centre and digital web application interfaces. This routine order win adds to the company's public sector project portfolio. Retail investors can track how public healthcare contracts impact the micro-cap company's order book and revenue growth.
whats_next: Execution timeline updates from the company
why_it_matters: Adds to order book for micro-cap shareholders
